chunks.label: [S1]
headingPath: Riansares 4R — offices, commercial premises and owners’ associations: scope and coordination
What changes when renovating an occupied office?
chunks.content:
## What changes when renovating an occupied office?

Phases, working hours, noise, dust, access, signage, safety, continued use and work areas must be agreed. Before quoting, define floor area, number of workstations, services, fire protection and other requirements for the activity and premises. Do not assume the requirements are the same as for a home.

chunks.label: [S2]
headingPath: Riansares 4R — energy efficiency, insulation and ventilation
chunks.content:
## Can replacing windows increase condensation?

If improved airtightness reduces air renewal and ventilation is not reviewed, indoor moisture balance may change. This does not mean new windows are inherently defective: thermal bridges, temperature and ventilation must be analysed. [CTE DB HS](https://www.codigotecnico.org/pdf/Documentos/HS/DBHS.pdf) regulates aspects of health and hygiene where applicable.

chunks.label: [S3]
headingPath: Insulation and energy renovation — informed decisions
Can internal insulation be installed without losing ventilation?
chunks.content:
## Can internal insulation be installed without losing ventilation?

Yes, with appropriate design, but it changes hygrothermal behaviour and reduces usable floor area. Vapour barriers must be assessed according to the solution and condensation risk, while maintaining adequate ventilation.

chunks.label: [S4]
headingPath: FAQ-072 — Can an office be renovated while people work?
chunks.content:
### FAQ-072 — Can an office be renovated while people work?

Sometimes, with phases, staff protection, dust and noise control, access and service interruptions. Verify premises-specific requirements.

**Category:** Offices. **Base:** EXT-NAHB-LIVING.

chunks.label: [S5]
headingPath: Offices and commercial premises — renovation while business continues
Can an office remain open during renovation?
chunks.content:
## Can an office remain open during renovation?

It depends on work segregation, noise, dust, access, escape routes and shared services. A phasing and safety plan must protect workers and visitors.
